name: oh-my-codex
description: Multi-agent orchestration layer for OpenAI Codex CLI

interface.shortDescription: Workflow layer and skill bundle for OpenAI Codex CLI.
interface.longDescription: Plugin = OMX skill/workflow discovery plus plugin-scoped companion metadata for hooks, MCP servers, and apps. Setup = runtime wiring and native agent TOMLs in both modes by default. In either mode, --disable-hooks disables OMX-owned hook registrations and related enablement, then returns before normal asset installation, configuration, AGENTS.md, HUD, and state setup. Legacy setup also installs prompt/skill copies; plugin setup enables official plugin-scoped hooks, archives legacy prompt copies, removes stale generated/non-installable native agents, and preserves user-authored or ambiguous roles during normal setup except that disabling Team (--disable-team or persisted disabled Team mode) backs up and removes team-executor.toml regardless of ownership. Scoped setup also maintains config, optional AGENTS.md, HUD, and runtime state.
